chapter: Famous Door, the union dispute and Stuff Smith's last years
title: Looking back: the Duke Ellington road not taken
summary: Everything changes; he wonders what would have happened had he built his name sooner by sitting behind Ellington, but he was afraid.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Everything changes. So when I look back on them things, you know, it was a great experience. I mean I tell you, I didn't know what road, you know. You wanted to know what happened when Sonny Greer -- wanted me to come with Duke in 1930 and I got cold feet. Ain't no telling what will happen, what would have happened to me if I'd made the -- built up a bigger name faster, you know.
Because even if I had sat behind him and put things there, you know, but I was afraid, you know.
